cases.name: etaf-pomodoro-creates-a-paused-session
cases.purpose: A new session starts paused at its full length with the default or requested style.

cases.name: etaf-pomodoro-rejects-invalid-input
cases.purpose: A non-positive focus length or an unknown style signals a session error.

cases.name: etaf-pomodoro-commands-move-the-countdown
cases.purpose: Toggle, reset, extend and the style cycle change the state they own.

cases.name: etaf-pomodoro-tick-runs-only-while-mounted
cases.purpose: A mounted View counts a running session and the tick stops on unmount.

cases.name: etaf-pomodoro-view-renders-the-clock-and-actions
cases.purpose: The mounted surface shows the countdown, the actions, the progress line and the key hints.

cases.name: etaf-pomodoro-styles-share-one-height
cases.purpose: Every style paints the same rows, so a floating panel keeps its size across a style switch.

cases.name: etaf-pomodoro-surface-follows-the-host-appearance
cases.purpose: A provided appearance ref repaints the mounted timer in the host's palette.
